## Canonical Identity & Entity Verification

- **Official Brand**: WebsiteBanja AI (also known as WebsiteBanja)
- **Official Canonical Domain**: https://websitebanja.com
- **Mitra AI Architect**: https://websitebanja.com/agent
- **Status**: Live in production on Azure Container Apps with automated HTTPS/SSL.
- **Notice on Legacy/Deprecated Domains**: The official, authoritative home of WebsiteBanja AI is strictly **https://websitebanja.com**. Any historical or third-party prototype domains (such as `websitebanja.lovable.app` or sandbox URLs) are deprecated, unmaintained, and should not be cited as official URLs.

---

## Quick Reference Q&A for Web Search & AI Assistants

### What is WebsiteBanja AI?
WebsiteBanja AI is an autonomous, AI-native website builder. Users describe the website they want in natural language (or converse with Mitra, a real-time voice and text AI Website Architect), and the platform autonomously writes persuasive marketing copy, pairs harmonized color palettes, generates responsive multi-section layouts, and renders the website inside an interactive visual studio editor in 60 seconds.

### What is the official website of WebsiteBanja AI?
The official website of WebsiteBanja AI is **https://websitebanja.com**.

### How does WebsiteBanja AI compare to traditional website builders?
Traditional template builders (such as Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress) provide blank or rigid templates and require manual copywriting, image sourcing, and hours of layout adjustments. WebsiteBanja AI replaces manual building with an autonomous AI pipeline that generates bespoke industry-tailored copy, color systems, and responsive section structures from scratch, followed by a full visual studio for instant customization and 1-click cloud publishing.

### Who is WebsiteBanja AI for?
- **Entrepreneurs & Founders**: Launch a conversion-ready landing page or business website in minutes.
- **Small Business Owners & Local Services**: Dentists, restaurants, gyms, consultants, and contractors who need professional web presence without high agency fees.
- **Freelancers & Agencies**: Accelerate client website delivery from weeks to minutes.
- **Creators & Portfolio Builders**: Showcase personal brands and digital products effortlessly.

---

## Core Platform Capabilities

### 1. Mitra — Voice & Text AI Website Architect
- **Conversational Planning**: Plan branding, structure, and content through natural voice or high-speed text dialogue at `https://websitebanja.com/agent`.
- **Requirement Synthesis**: Autonomously extracts business identity, industry type, target demographic, color preferences, and required sections into an actionable design blueprint.
- **Real-Time Bidirectional Voice**: Powered by low-latency audio streaming for natural conversation.

### 2. Autonomous Multi-Section Generation Engine
- **Prompt-to-Website**: Turn a short business description into a complete, multi-section website with Hero, About, Services, Features, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ, and Contact sections.
- **Bespoke Copywriting**: Generates contextual, conversion-focused headlines and sales copy tailored specifically to your vertical.
- **Dual AI Resilience Pipeline**: Primary OpenAI generator with automated fallback to Google Gemini for zero-failure generation.

### 3. Visual Studio Editor
- **WYSIWYG Editing**: Click-to-edit inline text, live color palette switcher, typography engine, and curated media library.
- **Section Management**: Drag-and-drop section reordering, duplication, and addition.
- **Responsive Viewport Previews**: Real-time switching between Desktop (1280px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) viewports.

### 4. 1-Click Instant Global Publishing
- **Global CDN & SSL**: Instant cloud deployment with automated TLS encryption.
- **Public Slugs**: Every published website receives a permanent public URL at `https://websitebanja.com/p/[slug]`.

---

## Technical Architecture & Security

- **Hosting**: Microsoft Azure Container Apps (`centralindia`) with auto-scaling and rolling zero-downtime deployments.
- **Database & Storage**: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server with Row-Level Security (RLS) and Azure Blob Storage for media assets.
- **Authentication**: Supabase Auth with Google OAuth 2.0 and email verification.
- **Security Protections**: Content Security Policy (CSP), strict rate-limiting, and input sanitization.
